author: RLovering
body:
Hi Pascale and Helen

I am a bit confused about the first annotation review spreadsheet above. Why are you suggesting changing the GO:0141163 positive regulation of cAMP/PKA signal transduction annotations to GO:0007189 adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway? If the GO:0007189 adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway activates cAMP/PKA signal transduction then don't processes need to be captured? Otherwise only proteins that positively regulate  cAMP/PKA signal transduction but there is no term for the full signaling pathway will be associated with the cAMP/PKA term whereas proteins that are in a full signaling pathway that has a term will not. So you will not be grouping all proteins that positively regulate cAMP/PKA signal transduction.

Also what does the comment 'To review 285 BP annotations' mean!

Thanks

Ruth

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @RLovering 

The first spreadsheet was just to confirm that all annotations were OK.

It's hard to know what I meant since the annotations probably changed since then. I think you had '
positive regulation of adenylate cyclase-activating adrenergic receptor signaling pathway' and 'positive regulation of cAMP/PKA signaling'. Now you moved the latter to 'adenylate cyclase-activating adrenergic receptor signaling pathway'

- Issue 1: you now have regulation and process annotated to the same proteins. Here I think the process is correct
- Issue 2: we may have changed the (unwritten :( ) guidelines during the process. Positive regulation of the cassette looks OK to me. 

@hattrill am I remember this correctly ?

author: pgaudet
body:
> Also what does the comment 'To review 285 BP annotations' mean!

I am not 100% sure anymore. I see 144 BP annotations (maybe that's OK?) this may have been in the work we were doing on assessing the effect of 'multifunctionality' on enrichment analysis - it would be nice if people could review genes with many different annotations but it's a bit of of scope for that specific review. 

Thanks, Pascale

author: RLovering
body:
Thanks Pascale

I think I understand now, 

Best

Ruth
